g.text: In RPN, numbers always enter before
Stack now holds Y = 16.0000 and X =
3. ADD SQUARES: Press [+]. The stack drops: 16.0000 + 9.0000 = 25.0000 in X!
CORE PRINCIPLE: THE FREEDOM FROM PARENTHESES
Evaluating √(3² + 4²) in traditional algebraic mode requires nested parentheses. In RPN,
you calculate from the inside out, exactly as you think! Intermediate numbers sit patiently
on the stack until an operator consumes them. Zero parentheses, zero syntax errors!
★ EXTENSION INVESTIGATION: KINETIC ENERGY: E = ½ m v²
Calculate kinetic energy for mass m=12 and velocity v=5: 0.5 [ENTER] 12 [×] 5 [↰] [x²] [×]
→ 150.0000! Zero parentheses! (Scan QR for 3D animated solution!)
